Review of validate_transfer (request_changes): The acceptance test `test_same_day_movements` is failing. The issue is that `validate_transfer` uses the raw `from_location` string to look up stock in the map returned by `on_hand_by_location`. If the `from_location` passed to the function differs in case or whitespace from the location stored in the movement records, the lookup will fail even if the locations are logically the same. You should normalize `from_location` (e.g., using the same logic as in `parse_location`) before the lookup to ensure consistency.
